guidetextdraw_copy_c.name: PetitionDHeadingText

guidetextdraw._value:
INSTRUCTIONS: Before using this form you must first discuss the nature of what you are seeking to petition with a petitions representative in the Registration and Records office.

If it is determined that this petition form can be used to submit your request, you must:

  • complete the petition form
  • provide relevant documentation pertaining to your request
  • pay th $20 petition fee to Student Business Services
  • bring the petition and proof of payment to Records and Registration and speak with a petitions representative
  • who will screen your petition to make sure it is complete
guidetextdraw.name: PetitionDInstructionsText

guidetextdraw._value:
FORM D / OTHER

 

This form cannot be used without first speaking to a petitions representative in the Registration and Records Office. There is no guarantee that the exception you are seeking is one that can be petitioned.

Reason for this request:

  1. This petition requires a statement that indicates what you are requesting, along with detailed background information regarding the reason(s) for submitting this request. Please be specific and clear.

  2. You must also include relevant documentation pertaining to your request.
